statement: Blind annotation from the Beinecke scan alone (full page, four strips, one close crop). A patterned tube descends from the top into a blue cloud-edged canopy; ten compartments hang from the canopy, each holding a two-line label and linked by a line to the head of one of ten nude female figures standing in a long green pool. A thin line runs from that pool down the left margin to a smaller blue pool crowded with about nineteen nude figures, from which a stream runs off the bottom of the page. Labels assigned from line ids and unit codes only, words not read from the transcription: the twenty Ln lines f75v.18-37 are taken as ten two-line labels in left-to-right order, each given to the figure below by its first line id. The Lt lines f75v.50-56 lie around the lower pool and are not tied to single figures; the first is given to the pool. The single-glyph L0 lines stand at the right edge of the upper right text column and point at no drawing.
